partnershipPlan: Two patient partners with atrial fibrillation, one of whom declined anticoagulation, review the outcome list and the plain-language summary; a general practitioner adviser reviews the grouping of interventions.
socialListening: No social media listening; the atrial fibrillation support group's forum summaries for 2025 and 2026 are read for reasons people give for declining treatment.

items.theme: Choosing not to take a blood thinner
items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I said no because my brother bled badly on one, and I do not want letters telling me I am a gap.
items.implication: Separate informed decline from missed treatment in every summary.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Nobody in the home ever asked Mum about it; the doctor visits once a month.
items.implication: Report whether care home residents were included in the reviewed studies.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We get the list every month, but there is no time in a ten-minute appointment to reopen that conversation.
items.implication: Compare interventions that add capacity with those that only remind.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Give us the list and a room and we will see them, but someone has to fund the sessions.
items.implication: Extract resource use for pharmacist-led review where reported.

summary: Four composite voices on informed decline, care homes, appointment time and pharmacist capacity.
